description: Flushes the Directus server cache so recent schema changes become visible, then optionally verifies that one collection is readable. Use it after create_collection, create_field or apply_schema when a collection or field is reported as missing; validate_collection_creation answers the narrower question of whether a new collection is ready. Mutating but not destructive: it discards cached data, never stored data, though the next requests are slower while the cache refills. Needs a token allowed to flush the cache, and it affects every client of the instance, not just this session.

collection.description: Specific collection to verify after refresh

name: refresh_collection_cache
